choices.content: A quadrilateral with three right angles
A quadrilateral with one right angle
A quadrilateral with diagonals of equal length

question.prompt: Which of the following quadrilaterals must be a rectangle?

solutions.explanation: When three angles are right angles, the fourth angle is also a right angle. A quadrilateral with four right angles is a rectangle. A quadrilateral with equal diagonals (such as an isosceles trapezoid) is not necessarily a rectangle. A parallelogram with perpendicular diagonals is a rhombus.
solutions.title: Use the rectangle criteria
